ai_notice: AI-generated translation. The translated voice is not a human recording.
source_empty_hint: Tap the mic and speak in any language
any_language_hint: The spoken language is detected automatically
privacy_notice: Your recording is sent to our secure server for translation and is not stored.
error_permission_denied: Microphone access is needed to record your voice.
error_permission_permanently_denied: Microphone access is blocked. Enable it in the app settings.
error_recording_too_short: The recording is too short. Speak for at least one second.
error_recording_empty: No voice was detected in the recording. Please record again.
error_recording_too_large: The recording is larger than 5 MB. Please record a shorter message.
error_recording_failed: The recording could not be saved. Please try again.
error_playback_failed: This audio could not be played.
error_network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
error_timeout: The translation took too long. Please try again.
error_server: The translation service failed. Please try again.
error_unsupported_input: This audio could not be understood. Please record again.
translating_hint: This can take up to a minute. Keep the app open.
error_languages_failed: The list of languages could not be loaded. Please try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
error_no_speech: No speech was recognized in the recording. Speak clearly and record again.
error_text_too_long: The speech is too long to translate. Please record a shorter message.
error_bad_request: The request could not be processed. Please record again.
error_unsupported_source_language: The spoken language is not supported. Please record in another language.
error_unsupported_target_language: This target language is not supported. Choose another language.
error_service_unavailable: The translation service is unavailable right now. Please try later.
error_session_failed: Could not connect to the translation service. Please try again.
